clubs.tacticsWhy: FotMob, 8 league games: possession 63.9% (1st of 18) and 533.5 accurate passes per match (1st). Possession wins in the final third are only 2.9 per match (14th, average 3.76) and tackles 13.5 per match (12th), but opponents complete just 78.9% of passes (4th lowest) and my whole-pitch PPDA proxy is 11.2 (5th lowest, average 13.3) -> press 3. My figures from FotMob match data: attempted long balls are 6.3% of passes (lowest in the league, average 12.8%) -> passing 1, tempo 2 (slow, patient). 26.0 attempted crosses per match (2nd, average 18.0) -> width 4. 62.2% of accurate passes in the opposition half (3rd) and 2.1 opponent offsides per match (2nd) -> line 4, style 'off'. 5 set-piece goals (2nd), but no source on routines or marking.
clubs.desc: Ajax kontrollerer kampene med lange perioder med bolden i en 4-3-3, spiller kort og tålmodigt op bagfra og søger mange indlæg fra kanterne.
uncertain: League starts (FotMob and ESPN agree): ter Stegen, Baas and Gloukh 7; Caio Henrique, Mokio, Klaassen, Brandt and Berghuis 6. Ties at 4 starts each: Rosa vs Gaaei (Gaaei injured on 10 Oct), Kehrer vs Bouwman (Kehrer started the last four), Arokodare vs Dolberg (Dolberg out for the season with a knee injury). The closest XI actually fielded is 2026-09-05 vs PSV (H), with Gaaei, Bouwman and Arokodare.
Caio Henrique and Berghuis were injured on 10 Oct; FotMob expects them back in mid-October.
Midfield sides: in the 4-3-3 games, FotMob and ESPN put Klaassen right and Brandt left with Mokio central. On 10 Oct, Brandt played right and Mokio left.
Name: Dutch media write 'Tolu'; ESPN/FotMob show 'Tolu Arokodare'. Use 'Arokodare' if surnames are preferred.
